fix.text: 10 to 14 seconds without a swing at the start of Firemaw, Ebonroc and Flamegor. Everyone else's start was about as slow, so it's the raid's opener, not you, but you asked for something.

review.verdict: 29% of all healing on Chromaggus, top on Broodlord too
review.summary: On Chromaggus you did 29% of the raid's healing, the most of anyone on any boss tonight, and you were top healer on Broodlord and second on Razorgore. A Lay on Hands and two Blessings of Protection where they counted. Nefarian (last of the healers, 90% overheal) and the thin consumables are the notes.

good.title: Chromaggus
good.text: 29% of all healing, top healer.

good.title: Broodlord
good.text: Top healer, 14%, with 39% overheal.

good.title: Saves
good.text: 1 Lay on Hands and 2 Blessings of Protection.

fix.title: Nefarian
fix.text: Last of the healers, 5% of the healing at 90% overheal.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mageblood every pull, food once: 1.3 buffs a pull against 2.

review.verdict: Frenzy duty done again, on the same bare consumables as Wednesday
review.summary: You put 2 Tranquilizing Shots each on Flamegor and Chromaggus and didn't die, and Vaelastrasz 85 and Firemaw 94 are personal bests. Otherwise it was a weak night: Ebonroc 39 and Flamegor 26 against a usual of about 80, last or close to it in raid damage on five bosses. You came with Mageblood and Mongoose and nothing else, 2 buffs a pull against 4, and no world buffs at all.

good.title: Tranquilizing Shots
good.text: 2 on Flamegor and 2 on Chromaggus.

good.title: Personal bests
good.text: Vaelastrasz 85 (before: 82) and Firemaw 94 (92).

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Zero deaths.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mageblood and Mongoose, nothing else, on every pull: 2 buffs a pull against 4 for the other DPS, and no world buffs on any snapshot. Same story as 7 October.

fix.title: Ebonroc and Flamegor
fix.text: 39 and 26, against your usual 83 and 78. Flamegor has the Tranquilizing Shot duty, Ebonroc doesn't.

review.verdict: Five personal bests in your fourth raid, still last of the rogues on four bosses
review.summary: A 53 average against your usual 27, with personal bests on Firemaw (90), Ebonroc (65), Flamegor (38), Chromaggus (78) and Nefarian (49), and no deaths. You were also the lowest of the four rogues on Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor, Chromaggus and Nefarian, on 2.5 consumable buffs a pull.

good.title: Personal bests
good.text: Firemaw 90 (before: 60), Ebonroc 65 (29), Chromaggus 78 (58), Nefarian 49 (43), Flamegor 38 (22).

good.title: Fire Protection on Flamegor
good.text: One of only two Fire Protection Potions drunk tonight.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mongoose and Giants every pull, food on 3, nothing else: 2.5 buffs a pull against 4.

fix.title: Vaelastrasz and Broodlord
fix.text: 24 and 34, both under your usual.

review.verdict: Nefarian 92 and Chromaggus 94, and a zero on Broodlord
review.summary: Right on your usual average (60 against 59) and no deaths. Nefarian 92 (eighth in raid damage), Chromaggus 94 and Firemaw 91 were good. Broodlord was a 0: 77 DPS and active a third of the fight. The log can't say why; if you were stuck somewhere, that's your answer.

good.title: Nefarian 92
good.text: Eighth in raid damage, over your usual 82.

good.title: Chromaggus 94 and Firemaw 91
good.text: Both well over your usual.

good.title: Ebonroc
good.text: 84, the top rogue on the boss.

fix.title: Broodlord
fix.text: 0 parse, 77 DPS, active 33% of the fight against 83% for the other DPS.

fix.title: Firemaw start
fix.text: 19 seconds without a swing from the pull.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mongoose, Juju Power and Scorpok every pull, nothing else: 3 buffs a pull against 4.

review.verdict: Seven polymorphs dispelled on Nefarian, the most, and very little healing elsewhere
review.summary: On Nefarian you dispelled 7 Wild Polymorphs, the most in the raid, and put out 3 Fear Wards. On Firemaw, Ebonroc and Chromaggus you did 2% of the healing each, last of the healers on the first two.

good.title: Wild Polymorph
good.text: 7 dispelled during the mage call, the most.

good.title: Fear Ward
good.text: 3 Fear Wards.

fix.title: Healing on the drakes
fix.text: 2% of the healing on Firemaw, Ebonroc and Chromaggus.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mageblood every pull, food twice.

50617.text: 7 Wild Polymorphs dispelled, most in the raid.

review.verdict: Top damage of the raid on four bosses, including Nefarian
review.summary: Most damage in the raid on Razorgore, Ebonroc, Chromaggus and Nefarian, second on Firemaw and Flamegor, a 93 average against your usual 69, and no deaths. Firemaw 97 is a personal best and Ebonroc 96 equals it.

good.title: Top of the meter four times
good.text: Razorgore 87, Ebonroc 96, Chromaggus 98, Nefarian 95: first in raid damage on all four.

good.title: Personal bests
good.text: Firemaw 97 (before: 96) and Ebonroc 96 (equal).

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Mongoose, Juju Power, Rage of Ages, Firewater and food on every pull.

fix.title: No flask
fix.text: Flask of the Titans on none of the six pulls with a snapshot. You topped the meter without it, which says what it's worth.

fix.title: Vaelastrasz
fix.text: 86, fourth in damage. Your one boss outside the top two.

review.verdict: A good BWL in your second raid with us: fourth on Firemaw, fifth on Chromaggus
review.summary: Your second raid in our logs (after ZG on Tuesday), with no deaths and a 70 average: Firemaw 95 (fourth in raid damage), Chromaggus 93 (fifth) and Ebonroc 89. Razorgore (27) and Broodlord (44, last of the warriors) are where the rest of the damage is.

good.title: Firemaw 95
good.text: Fourth highest damage in the raid.

good.title: Chromaggus 93
good.text: Fifth highest damage.

good.title: Warrior work
good.text: 31 Sunder Armors, 2 kicks, 2 Sapper Charges, 4 Mighty Rage Potions.

fix.title: Razorgore and Broodlord
fix.text: 27 and 44, the second of them last of the ten warriors.

fix.title: No flask or Zanza
fix.text: Mongoose, Juju Power, Firewater and food every pull, but no flask or Zanza.

review.verdict: Twelve points over your usual on four world buffs and no flask
review.summary: A 78 average against your usual 66 and no deaths, with Razorgore 83 (fourth in raid damage), Firemaw 90 and Ebonroc 89. You did it with four world buffs where most of the raid had six or seven, and 3.3 consumable buffs a pull. Flamegor (45) was the dip.

good.title: Razorgore
good.text: 83, fourth in raid damage, against your usual 69.

good.title: Over your usual
good.text: Firemaw 90 (82), Ebonroc 89 (82), Chromaggus 87 (83).

good.title: Great Rage Potions
good.text: 7 used over the raid, plus 2 kicks.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Mongoose, Juju Power and Scorpok every pull, but no flask and no food: 3.3 buffs a pull against 4 for the other DPS.

fix.title: Flamegor
fix.text: 45 against your usual 72.

review.verdict: Top healer of the raid on five of eight bosses, in your first raid with us
review.summary: Your first raid in our logs, and you led the healing on Razorgore (20%), Firemaw, Ebonroc (19%), Flamegor (17%) and Nefarian (15%), with low overheal on Flamegor (32%) and Nefarian (41%). You also came with Zanza and Mageblood on every pull.

good.title: Top healer five times
good.text: Razorgore, Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor and Nefarian.

good.title: Efficient
good.text: 32% overheal on Flamegor and 41% on Nefarian while doing the most healing.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Zanza and Mageblood every pull, 4 Mana Potions: 3.8 buffs a pull against 2 for the other healers.

fix.title: Broodlord
fix.text: Your one quiet boss: active half the fight, fifth of the healers.

review.verdict: Seventeen points over your usual, 31 Demoralizing Shouts, and no flask
review.summary: A 77 average against your usual 60, with Firemaw 94, Chromaggus 91 and Broodlord 90 the high points, and no deaths. You kept Demoralizing Shout up on the bosses (31 casts) and put Sunder Armor on too. The weak spots are Nefarian (72, usually 83) and Ebonroc, where you were the second lowest warrior.

good.title: Well over your usual
good.text: Firemaw 94 (usual 80), Chromaggus 91 (84, a personal best), Broodlord 90 while tanking, Vaelastrasz 73 (53).

good.title: Demoralizing Shout
good.text: 31 Demoralizing Shouts and 17 Sunder Armors over the raid.

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Zero deaths in eight boss pulls.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 3.2 buffs a boss pull against 5 for the other tanks: Zanza, Mongoose and Giants every pull, but no flask, no food and Gordok Green Grog once.

fix.title: Nefarian and Ebonroc
fix.text: Nefarian 72 against your usual 83, and Ebonroc 76 with 13 seconds of nothing at the start, tenth of eleven warriors.

fix.title: Chromaggus breath
fix.text: Frost Burn hit you for 2,125, more than anyone it caught.

review.verdict: Thirty points over your usual on the best consumables in the raid, and standing in Chromaggus's breath
review.summary: A 71 average against your usual 41, with personal bests on Firemaw (94), Ebonroc (88) and Flamegor (70), and 8 consumable buffs a pull, more than anyone in the raid. Two things to fix: Razorgore (13, last of the DPS) and five breath hits on Chromaggus, which as DPS you shouldn't take.

good.title: Personal bests
good.text: Firemaw 94 (before: 69), Ebonroc 88 (54), Flamegor 70 (65).

good.title: Best prepared in the raid
good.text: 8 buffs per boss pull: Zanza, Fortitude, Mongoose, Gordok, Kreeg's and more every pull.

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Zero deaths.

fix.title: Chromaggus's breaths
fix.text: Five breath hits, including the most Ignite Flesh damage in the raid (3,888). Only the tank is meant to take the breaths; the raid hides out of his line of sight.

fix.text: 13, last of the 27 DPS.
